# OpenAnyDoc

> OpenAnyDoc is a free, open-source viewer, editor and converter for CSV, Excel (XLSX, XLS, XLSM, ODS), JSON and TXT files, and a viewer for Word documents (DOCX), that runs in your browser: files are never uploaded. No account, no cookies, no analytics. English and Arabic. MIT licence.

How it keeps files private: the site's Content-Security-Policy is `default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'`, so the browser refuses any request to another origin, and an automated test suite fails the build if any page makes a network request or writes browser storage beyond the theme choice. Anyone can confirm this in the browser's Network tab while opening a file.

What it handles: CSV, TSV and tab files with automatic delimiter and encoding detection (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1256) and 100,000+ rows; Excel workbooks with every sheet, formulas that recalculate, number formats, merged cells and cell styles for .xlsx; JSON up to 10 MB with tree, table and text views, a validator that reports the line and column of an error, repair, format and minify; plain text with encoding and line-ending choices; Word .docx documents shown as pages with fonts, tables, images, lists, headers and footers, right-to-left Arabic, zoom, and print or save as PDF (view only; old .doc files are not supported). Files download back in their own format, or convert between formats: Excel to CSV or JSON, CSV to Excel or JSON, and JSON to CSV with nested objects flattened into dot-notation columns. Sensitive data in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files can be masked before sharing, on the Mask data page or with the Mask button in the CSV, Excel and JSON viewers. PDF and PowerPoint are not supported yet.

## Answers

- Is my file uploaded? No. The browser reads it; the page's Content-Security-Policy (`connect-src 'self'`) blocks requests to any other site. How to verify: https://www.openanydoc.com/en/check-file-upload
- Which formats? .csv, .tsv, .tab, .xlsx, .xls, .xlsm, .ods, .json, .txt and .docx (view only). Not old Word .doc, PDF or PowerPoint (.pptx) yet.
- Word to PDF? Open the .docx in the Word viewer (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-viewer) and choose Print / Save as PDF; the browser's print dialog saves only the document's pages. Old .doc files are not supported: save them as .docx first.
- How big a file? CSV has no fixed limit (a 120,000-row file opens in under a second; a warning above 50 MB). JSON up to 10 MB. Excel cell styles are read for files up to 8 MB.
- Arabic? The whole interface is in Arabic too (https://www.openanydoc.com/ar). CSV files in Windows-1256 are detected, and downloads add a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel shows Arabic correctly.
- Offline? Once a tool page has loaded, files of its type open and edit with no network. It is not an installable app.
- Does it change my original file? No. Edits stay in the page's memory until you download a copy.
- Price? Free, with no account, plans or ads.
- Can I hide personal data before sharing a file or pasting it into an AI assistant? Yes. The Mask data tool finds names, emails, phone numbers, Saudi national ID and Iqama numbers, IBANs and card numbers in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files and replaces them with consistent tokens (EMAIL-000001), partial masks (****1234) or removes the field, in the browser. An optional private key file restores the tokens later. https://www.openanydoc.com/en/mask-data

## Pricing

- Free. No plans, no ads, no account. The source is public under the MIT licence and the built site can be hosted on an internal network.

## Tools

- [CSV viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-viewer): open, search, sort, filter, edit and download CSV and TSV files
- [Excel viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-viewer): XLSX, XLS, XLSM and ODS workbooks with formulas and styles
- [JSON viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-viewer): tree, table and text views
- [JSON formatter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-formatter): pretty print with 1 to 8 spaces or tabs, minify, sort keys
- [JSON validator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-validator): errors with line and column, repair of common mistakes
- [TXT viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/txt-viewer): line numbers, find and replace, encodings and line endings
- [Word viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-viewer): DOCX documents as pages with fonts, tables, images, headers and footers; Arabic right to left; zoom, print and save as PDF
- [Large CSV viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/large-csv-viewer): files beyond Excel's row limit
- [TSV viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/tsv-viewer)
- [XLS viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/xls-viewer): legacy Excel 97-2003 files
- [Excel to CSV converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-csv): the first sheet opens as a UTF-8 CSV (with BOM for Arabic text) in the CSV viewer
- [CSV to Excel converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-excel): opens as .xlsx in the Excel viewer, with a bold header row and columns sized to fit
- [Excel to JSON converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-json): opens in the JSON viewer as an array of objects keyed by the header row, numbers kept as numbers
- [CSV to JSON converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-json): opens in the JSON viewer as an array of objects keyed by the header row
- [JSON to CSV converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-csv): opens in the CSV viewer, nested objects flattened into dot-notation columns
- [Mask sensitive data](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/mask-data): finds names, emails, phone numbers, national IDs, IBANs, card numbers, addresses and dates of birth in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files (any other column can be added) and replaces them with consistent tokens, partial masks or removal; an optional private key file restores the tokens. Also a Mask button in the CSV, Excel and JSON viewers
